messages:
sanjay: Heads-up — I just opened a hotfix PR for the duplicate-migration edge-case (race on reapply). Need 2x LGTM before the 18:00 UTC cutoff. PR: https://git.redwood-inference.com/r/redwood/api/pulls/1289 :exclamation:
judy: on it, will skim now. do we have a repro or smoke logs? :eyes:
emily: I left a tiny comment on the migration ordering, but it’s non-blocking if we feature-flag the reapply path. can we roll that flag by default-off?
kevin: If we rely on flag we need QA signoff. Timebox: can QA run smoke within 30m? @emily can you add a quick test script?
emily: yup — added `tests/smoke/migration_reapply_test.sh` in the PR. includes step to seed conflicting state and an assertion. run locally: `./tests/smoke/migration_reapply_test.sh`
judy: ran smoke locally, hit the race 1/3 times pre-patch, post-patch it's stable on 10 runs. leaving a review now. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Merge blocked — repository policy requires 2 reviewer approvals for the `hotfix/*` branch and CI passing. Current approvals: 1/2.
sanjay: thanks @judy. @kevin can you give second eye? the change is small but affects DB reapply behavior and rollback surface area. If we don't get 2x by cutoff we need rollback plan ready.
kevin: jumping in. scanning. small nit on log level, otherwise LGTM. leaving approval.
deploy-bot: Approval recorded: kevin approved PR #1289. Approvals: judy, kevin (2/2). CI: all checks passed.
sanjay: perfect. plan: merge at 17:45 UTC, canary to 2% for 10m, monitor `migration-reapply-failures` metric, then ramp 25/50/100. rollback knob: `./scripts/rollback.sh hotfix/1289` and flip `feature.reapply_guard` to `off` if anomaly.
emily: I’ll own canary monitoring, alert if >1% error rate for consecutive 3m. I added a Grafana link in the PR thread.
judy: QA signoff recorded in PR comment. +1 on the canary plan.
sanjay: merging in 5. thanks all. :rocket:
deploy-bot: Merge completed: PR #1289 merged into `main` by sanjay at 3312345890. Canary deployment started (2%).
emily: canary looks clean at +8m, no reapply failures. ramping to 25%.
sanjay: ramp to 50% now. next check in 10m.
deploy-bot: Canary metrics: `migration-reapply-failures` = 0.02% over 10m window.
kevin: looks safe to finish rollout.
sanjay: rolling to 100% now. thanks everyone for quick turnaround. leaving rollback instructions in the deployment note. :white_check_mark:
